allTrialWordP95.scope: Nearest-rank first-word delivery statistic with every recorded trial in the denominator. A missing retained word is an unsatisfied delivery outcome, never replaced with an invented numeric latency. This is separate from the observed-word-only distribution and from answer correctness; it is not a population percentile.

scope: Dependent diagnostic cases deliberately selected from original tails and medians, replayed with frozen context and fresh meetings. Descriptive matched observations, not population p95 or isolated provider compute. Word latency retains erroneous and cancelled trials with visible words; missing words remain explicit. Independent verdicts, when available, are provisional model judgments over all recorded trials, not executable correctness certification.
